label: Trees
description: Named trees and distinctive tree-form plants, including palms, cacti, conifers and flowering trees.
notes: Whole-tree identities and distinctive silhouettes belong here, including palms, tree ferns and tree-form cacti. plant.flower holds blossoms as the subject, while plant.houseplant holds indoor specimens and bonsai. Values are singular names with their own a or an, adding tree only where that is natural English. Kind chips overlap; ancient_iconic highlights monumental or especially recognizable forms rather than claiming that every specimen is ancient. Spanish moss is explicit in the live-oak entry rather than assumed for all oaks.
